description: Performant, batteries-included completion plugin for Neovim with LSP support, snippet integration, signature help, and fuzzy matching. Works out of the box with no configuration required.
author: saghen
tagline: Fast async completion engine with LSP, snippets, and fuzzy matching

options.label: Keymaps
options.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts for blink.cmp completion actions. Select a preset for sensible defaults, then override individual keys as needed.

commands.name: show
commands.label: Show Menu
commands.description: Shows the completion menu. Can optionally filter to specific providers.

commands.name: show_and_insert
commands.label: Show & Insert
commands.description: Shows menu and inserts the first item.

commands.name: show_and_insert_or_accept_single
commands.label: Show & Insert or Accept Single
commands.description: Shows menu and inserts first item, or accepts if only one match.

commands.name: hide
commands.label: Hide Menu
commands.description: Hides the completion menu.

commands.name: cancel
commands.label: Cancel
commands.description: Reverts auto-inserted preview text and hides menu.

commands.name: accept
commands.label: Accept
commands.description: Accepts the currently selected completion item.

commands.name: accept_and_enter
commands.label: Accept & Enter
commands.description: Accepts selected item and feeds Enter key. Useful for cmdline mode.

commands.name: select_and_accept
commands.label: Select & Accept
commands.description: Accepts selected item, or first item if none selected.

commands.name: select_accept_and_enter
commands.label: Select, Accept & Enter
commands.description: Accepts selected or first item and feeds Enter.

commands.name: select_prev
commands.label: Select Previous
commands.description: Moves selection to the previous item in the list.

commands.name: select_next
commands.label: Select Next
commands.description: Moves selection to the next item in the list.

commands.name: insert_prev
commands.label: Insert Previous
commands.description: Inserts (auto-insert) the previous item. Triggers completions if none available.

commands.name: insert_next
commands.label: Insert Next
commands.description: Inserts (auto-insert) the next item. Triggers completions if none available.

commands.name: show_documentation
commands.label: Show Documentation
commands.description: Shows documentation for the selected item.

commands.name: hide_documentation
commands.label: Hide Documentation
commands.description: Hides the documentation window.

commands.name: scroll_documentation_up
commands.label: Scroll Docs Up
commands.description: Scrolls the documentation window up by 4 lines.

commands.name: scroll_documentation_down
commands.label: Scroll Docs Down
commands.description: Scrolls the documentation window down by 4 lines.

commands.name: show_signature
commands.label: Show Signature
commands.description: Shows the function signature help window.

commands.name: hide_signature
commands.label: Hide Signature
commands.description: Hides the signature help window.

commands.name: scroll_signature_up
commands.label: Scroll Signature Up
commands.description: Scrolls signature help up.

commands.name: scroll_signature_down
commands.label: Scroll Signature Down
commands.description: Scrolls signature help down.

commands.name: snippet_forward
commands.label: Snippet Forward
commands.description: Jumps to the next snippet placeholder.

commands.name: snippet_backward
commands.label: Snippet Backward
commands.description: Jumps to the previous snippet placeholder.

commands.name: fallback
commands.label: Fallback
commands.description: Runs the next non-blink keymap, or the built-in Neovim binding.

commands.name: fallback_to_mappings
commands.label: Fallback to Mappings
commands.description: Runs the next non-blink keymap only (not built-in Neovim behavior).

presets.label: Super-Tab (Tab/Shift-Tab, Tab to accept)
presets.description: Uses Tab for selection, snippet jumping, and accepting

presets.label: None (define all keymaps manually)
presets.description: Disables all built-in keymaps. Define everything yourself.

options.label: Keyword Match Range
options.description: Controls how the completion keyword is determined. 'prefix' matches only the text before the cursor. 'full' matches text before AND after the cursor, so typing in the middle of a word still finds full matches.

options.label: Show on Keyword
options.description: Automatically show the completion menu when typing alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.

options.label: Show Inside Snippets
options.description: Show the completion menu while inside an active snippet. Disable this when using 'super-tab' or 'enter' presets to avoid conflicts with snippet navigation.

options.label: Pre-select First Item
options.description: Automatically select the first completion item when the menu opens. When disabled, no item is selected until you press the next/prev keys.

options.label: Auto-insert on Selection
options.description: Insert a temporary preview of the selected item as you navigate the list. The preview is removed if you cancel. Requires pre-select to be useful.

options.label: Auto-add Brackets
options.description: Automatically insert parentheses after completing a function or method, placing the cursor inside. Uses LSP semantic tokens to determine if brackets are needed. Note: some LSPs add brackets themselves regardless of this setting.

options.label: Auto-show Completion Menu
options.description: Show the completion popup menu automatically as you type. Disable to only show the menu when manually triggered (default Ctrl+Space).

options.label: Menu Border Style
options.description: Border style for the completion popup menu window. 'none' is equivalent to Neovim's default (no border), which is blink.cmp's actual default.

options.label: Menu Transparency
options.description: Transparency level of the completion menu window. 0 = fully opaque, 100 = fully transparent.

options.label: Auto-show Documentation
options.description: Automatically show the documentation window when an item is selected in the completion menu. Requires auto_show_delay_ms to avoid flickering.

options.label: Documentation Show Delay (ms)
options.description: How long to wait after selecting an item before showing the documentation window. Increase this if the doc window feels intrusive.

options.label: Documentation Window Border
options.description: Border style for the documentation popup window. blink.cmp defaults to 'padded' for this window.

options.label: Enable Ghost Text
options.description: Show a preview of the currently selected completion item as dimmed virtual text inline in the buffer. Pairs well with disabling auto-show so the menu stays hidden until manually triggered.

options.label: Active Completion Sources
options.description: Ordered list of completion sources to use. 'lsp' provides language server completions, 'path' completes file paths, 'snippets' provides snippet completions, and 'buffer' completes from the current buffer text. Remove sources you don't want.

options.label: Minimum Keyword Length
options.description: Minimum number of characters you must type before completion results are shown. Set to 0 to show results immediately, or 2-3 to reduce noise in large files.

options.label: Enable Cmdline Completion
options.description: Enable completion in Neovim's command-line mode (the ':' prompt). Provides completions for Ex commands, file paths, and command arguments.

options.label: Snippet Backend
options.description: Which snippet engine to use for expanding and navigating snippets. 'default' uses Neovim's built-in vim.snippet (requires Neovim 0.10+). Choose the option that matches the snippet plugin you have installed.

options.label: Enable Signature Help
options.description: Show a floating window with function signature information (parameter names and types) as you type inside a function call. This is an experimental opt-in feature.

options.label: Show Signature on Keyword
options.description: Show the signature help window after typing any alphanumeric character, hyphen, or underscore — not just trigger characters like '('. Useful for seeing signatures earlier.

options.label: Show Signature on Enter Insert
options.description: Show the signature help window automatically when entering insert mode, if the cursor is already inside a function call.

options.label: Signature Window Border
options.description: Border style for the signature help floating window. blink.cmp defaults to no border for this window.

options.label: Show Documentation in Signature Window
options.description: Include the full parameter documentation text inside the signature help window, in addition to the signature itself.

options.label: Nerd Font Variant
options.description: Controls icon spacing to match your installed Nerd Font variant. 'mono' is for Nerd Font Mono (single-width icons), 'normal' is for standard Nerd Font (double-width icons).

options.label: Use nvim-cmp Highlight Groups
options.description: Fall back to nvim-cmp highlight groups when your colorscheme doesn't natively support blink.cmp. Enable this if items appear without color in the completion menu.

options.label: Fuzzy Matcher Implementation
options.description: Which fuzzy matching engine to use. The Rust implementation (frizbee) is faster and supports typo tolerance and frecency scoring. The Lua implementation is a pure-Lua fallback with no extra dependencies.

options.label: Proximity Boost
options.description: Boost the score of completion items that match words near the cursor in the current buffer. Helps surface contextually relevant items. Only applies to the Rust implementation.

options.label: Frecency Scoring
options.description: Track which completion items you use most frequently and most recently, and boost their score. Frequently accepted items will rise to the top of the list over time. Only applies to the Rust implementation.

functions.name: accept
functions.description: Accept the currently selected completion item

functions.name: cancel
functions.description: Cancel the current completion, undoing any auto-inserted preview

functions.name: select_next
functions.description: Select the next completion item in the list

functions.name: select_prev
functions.description: Select the previous completion item in the list

functions.name: snippet_forward
functions.description: Jump forward to the next snippet placeholder

functions.name: snippet_backward
functions.description: Jump backward to the previous snippet placeholder

functions.name: is_visible
functions.description: Check whether the completion menu is currently visible

functions.name: snippet_active
functions.description: Check whether the cursor is currently inside an active snippet

functionTemplates.label: Show Completion Menu
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Manually open the blink.cmp completion menu
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Triggers the completion menu to appear at the cursor position, showing all available completions from configured sources.

functionTemplates.label: Accept Completion
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Accept the currently highlighted completion item
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Inserts the currently selected completion item and closes the menu. Use this in a keymap node to set up a custom accept binding.
